      goto bb3
  instance mi0 function=@fn2 <- encode
  instance mi1 function=@fn4 <- encodeOption
  instance mi2 function=@fn5 <- encode
  instance mi3 function=@fn6 <- encodeOption
  str @str0 "illegal state"
  str @str1 "string"
